answer: The sable test I would run is Blacksmith forge membership with farriers registration attestation: each membership is judged forge work logged with the farriers register, so a farm must run a hundred real forges, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the prism of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out. The ocean is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
